name: Founders Fund
summary: A San Francisco venture firm founded in 2005 by Peter Thiel, Ken Howery and Luke Nosek, with about $17 billion under management by 2025. It was the first institutional investor in SpaceX and Palantir, an early Facebook investor, and the lead backer of Anduril; it and Andreessen Horowitz are often described as the dominant forces in new defense tech.

sources.title: Peter Thiel's Founders Fund closes $4.6 billion growth fund — CNBC

connections.name: Luke Nosek
connections.description: Co-founder; left in 2017 to start Gigafund.

connections.name: Trae Stephens
connections.description: Partner; co-founder and executive chairman of Anduril.

connections.name: Elon Musk
connections.description: Invested $20 million in SpaceX in 2008 as its first institutional backer, a stake that paid off in SpaceX's June 2026 IPO; it also backed the Boring Company and Neuralink. Luke Nosek led the deal and joined SpaceX's board.

sources.title: Founders Fund, Andreessen Horowitz, Valor, and the biggest VC winners from SpaceX's IPO — Fortune

connections.name: Palmer Luckey
connections.description: An early Oculus investor; it seeded Anduril in 2017, led its 2018 Series A and put $1 billion, its largest-ever check, into the 2025 round.

sources.title: Anduril raises at $30.5 billion valuation, led by Founders Fund — Fortune

connections.name: Alex Karp
connections.description: The first institutional investor in Palantir, which Karp runs as CEO.

connections.name: Max Levchin
connections.description: Led the $100 million Series D in 2016 of Affirm, Levchin's company, and joined later rounds.
